name: poiss-bge-m3-reranker
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3 (config.json max_position_embeddings 8194). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: cross-encoder (XLM-RoBERTa), full bidirectional attention over query+passage
notes: ADDED 2026-11-03. A finetune of BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.568 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-18. CAVEAT: in-domain only. The base column is BGE-Reranker-v2-m3 zero-shot on POI pairs, and the pool is the fine-tuned retriever's top-1000 from a 72M-POI corpus that is not distributed, so the table is not reproducible without rebuilding the corpus embeddings. The reference that matters is the retriever's own bi-encoder order (MRR 85.5, N@5 61.5): the honest reading is that reranking adds +4.2 MRR and +5.3 nDCG@5 over not reranking at all, and that the generic cross-encoder is actively harmful on this domain (MRR 50.0, far below no reranking). No multilingual or out-of-domain reranking result is published.
